title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Donuts Glazed Biscuit 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy Vape Co.’s Seriously Donuts Glazed Biscuit e-liquid is a super-comforting blend that brings together two popular sweet treats. This flavour merges a warm, freshly baked Donut base with the rich, buttery notes of crumbled Biscuit. A smooth layer of sweet Sugar glaze completes the profile, delivering a layered, textured bakery experience that works perfectly as a reliable everyday vape. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mods and sub-ohm tanks .
